question_text: Which demo booth attracted bigger crowds — NVIDIA or Intel? Roughly how much more popular was the winner?
answer_text: The NVIDIA demo booth attracted bigger crowds. It was roughly 116.8 attendees more popular than the Intel booth.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) WHERE ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'NVIDIA' AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN sum(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_hc, 'NVIDIA' AS booth
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) WHERE ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'Intel' AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN sum(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_hc, 'Intel' AS booth
}
WITH collect(avg_hc) AS avg_hc_values, collect(booth) AS booths
RETURN 
  CASE 
    WHEN avg_hc_values[0] > avg_hc_values[1] THEN booths[0] 
    ELSE booths[1] 
  END AS winner,
  abs(avg_hc_values[0] - avg_hc_values[1]) AS popularity_difference
